The GenStone 90º Outside Corner panel can also be used to create a stone column. As opposed to GenStone Pillar Panels which are designed to encase an 7.75 inch square post, 4 Outside Corners fit seamlessly around a 16.75 inch square post.

If your post is less than 16.75 inches on each side, you can fur the post out with wood strips on each side before attaching the panels. Each Outside Corner also provides 22.50 inches of height coverage making measuring how many panels you will need easy.

To determine how many panels you need, measure the height of your column in inches and then divide that measurement by 22.50 in order to find out how many rows of 4 corner panels you will need.

About Pillar Panels (Up to 7.75")

GenStone Pillar Panels are designed to wrap an 7.75 inch square post. Each panel is 24 inches tall and can be stacked vertically for taller posts or cut down for shorter posts. The panels can be terminated into a ceiling or finished with one of our flat or peaked pillar caps.

Watch video

About Column Wraps (Up to 16.75" Post)

Four GenStone 90º corner panels are designed to fit together around a 16.75 inch post. The corner panels are 22.50 inches tall can be stacked vertically or cut down for accommodate a certain height. The corner panels can terminate into a ceiling or finished with one of our flat or peaked column caps.
